title: aeiou benchmark rules
description: A benchmark's rules (contract 0.11, DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78 points 6 and 9): one file for many use cases, naming no parameter. `freeze` acts on states as a whole; `constraints` are expressions over the runner's `fact.` and `result.` names, each checked at the latest time a name it reads is known (resolve, the gate, or after the run). `aeiou-params lock CASE --rules FILE` copies both into a use case's lock. aeiou ships the mechanism and no WG rules file (PROJECT_BRIEF.md §8).

scale.description: Every `scale` parameter becomes required: the submission sizes it.

identity_options.description: Every identity option of the runner (seed, posix, cache, s3, time_scale, rank_rotate, write_compress) is locked at the value the lock gives, else its default: a run that gives another is refused.

expr.description: Infix: `or`, `and`, `not`, one comparison, `+ - * div mod`, unary `-`, `min(a, b)`, `max(a, b)`, numbers, parentheses, and `fact.NAME` and `result.NAME` (runner/REFERENCE.md lists them).
